YW.eval: (() => { const T = game.THREE, NH = game.nicoHouse, yy = NH.group.userData.yardY || (() => 0); const w = (x, y, z) => NH.toWorld(new T.Vector3(x, yy(x, z) + y, z)); const tgt = w(-12.5, 0.6, -0.5), eye = w(-18.5, 2.2, 5.5); game.cameraOverride = (dt, cam) => { cam.position.copy(eye); cam.up.set(0, 1, 0); cam.lookAt(tgt); if (cam.fov !== 62) { cam.fov = 62; cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); } return true; }; })()
